user.title: Connect to a Data Enabler
user.description: Enter the IPv4 address of each Philips Color Kinetics Data Enabler, one per line. The integration sends a read-only supply poll to each address. Add the integration again if a later supply needs a different KiNET mode.

data_description.hosts: Example: 172.16.10.41. One address per line, or separated by commas.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach {host} on UDP port 6038. Check the address and that Home Assistant is on the same network. Only a read-only supply poll was sent.
error.invalid_host: Enter one or more IPv4 unicast addresses, one per line.
error.no_hosts: Enter at least one Data Enabler IP address.
error.already_configured: One of these Data Enablers is already configured.

abort.already_configured: This Data Enabler is already configured.

init.title: Color Kinetics options
init.description: Change the light output, the order fixtures chase in, or named groups.

output.title: Light output
output.description: Light data is unicast KiNET. v2 PORTOUT with header version 1 matches OLA. If a fixture stays dark, try header version 2, then v1 DMXOUT. The output port applies to PORTOUT only. These settings apply to every supply in this entry.

data_description.hosts: One IPv4 address per line. A new address is polled before it is saved. Removing an address stops sending to that supply.
data_description.protocol: PORTOUT is KiNET v2. DMXOUT is KiNET v1.
data_description.output_port: Physical output on the Data Enabler, 1 to 16. This supply uses port 1. Ignored for DMXOUT.
data_description.manual_fixtures: One fixture per line if discovery misses it: serial_or_label, dmx_start[, label]. DMX start is 1-based, as QuickPlay shows it. An 8-digit hex token is a serial. With more than one supply, start the line with the supply IP. Example: 880055BE, 1, Oak left
data_description.default_fade: Seconds to fade when a light command does not set transition. 0 snaps on and off. 1.5 is the default.

fixture_order.title: Fixture order
fixture_order.description: Drag the handles to order discovered fixtures. Current order: {order}. The list is stored by serial, so renames survive. Fixtures found later are added at the end. A fixture that is missing from a scan keeps its place.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Add a group such as Tree Run or Oaks, edit one, or choose Done.

group_edit.title: Edit {name}
group_edit.description: Drag members into the order this group's effects will follow. The group keeps its id if you rename it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach {host}. The new address was not saved. Only a read-only supply poll was sent.
error.invalid_host: Enter one or more IPv4 unicast addresses, one per line.
error.no_hosts: Leave at least one Data Enabler address.
error.already_configured: One of these Data Enablers is already configured on another entry.
error.invalid_group: Enter a name for the group.
error.duplicate_group: A group with this name already exists.

scan_in_progress.message: A fixture scan is already running on {host}.

look_name.message: Enter a name for the look.

look_target.message: Choose the Data Enabler when more than one Color Kinetics entry is loaded.

save_look.name: Save look
save_look.description: Save the current fixture colors, brightness, and any running effect, speed, intensity, palette, and direction as a named look.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name for this look. A name that matches an existing look in any case is rejected.

device_id.name: Data Enabler
device_id.description: Which entry to save when more than one Color Kinetics integration is loaded. Pick the Data Enabler. A fixture on that supply selects the same entry.

recall_look.name: Recall look
recall_look.description: Restore a saved look. Fixtures that are no longer present are skipped.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the look to recall. Matching ignores case.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Seconds to fade to the look. Leave empty to change at once.

device_id.name: Data Enabler
device_id.description: Which entry to recall when more than one Color Kinetics integration is loaded. Pick the Data Enabler. A fixture on that supply selects the same entry.

delete_look.name: Delete look
delete_look.description: Delete a saved look. Matching ignores case.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the look to delete.

device_id.name: Data Enabler
device_id.description: Which entry to update when more than one Color Kinetics integration is loaded. Pick the Data Enabler. A fixture on that supply selects the same entry.

scan_failed.title: Fixture scan failed for {host}
scan_failed.description: The Data Enabler did not return a fixture list. Fixtures found earlier were left in place. Check the network and press Rescan fixtures. The scan is read-only, but it takes about 14 seconds and may blink fixtures.

supply_unreachable.title: Data Enabler {host} did not answer
supply_unreachable.description: A read-only supply poll got no reply. Light commands are still sent to the last known address. Discovery results were not cleared.
